name: Bastiaan
headline: Turn Greenchoice’s usage data into contracts that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells fixed and dynamic tariffs, solar panels, heat pumps and charging points to every visitor the same way, whether they arrive for a contract or a home upgrade.

Once a customer logs in to Mijn Greenchoice, their usage, their tariff and the upgrades they never open are your strongest signals for the next offer or cancellation. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.

Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns for your home and business segments are built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer who is about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Per customer, the AI reads usage, tariff changes and contract end dates, then picks the right offer, channel and moment to keep them. Tested across email and Mijn Greenchoice.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the right tariff to each customer
cases.text: Next best tariff or add-on per customer, such as solar panels or a charging point, triggered by what they actually use. No more blanket upgrade mails to people already on the right tariff.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every customer engaged each week
cases.text: Personal tips and usage insights in Mijn Greenchoice and email, so every customer has a reason to log in again. Each message is chosen for that customer alone.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
